verdict.rationale: Luma is an AI video generation product, so a script-to-presenter avatar workflow is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence, however, shows only general text/image/video-to-video generation with character references and facial-expression transfer. There is no documented feature for pasting a script and getting a talking, lip-synced presenter with stock or custom avatars, and the adjacent character-consistency features do not count toward this story.
